source_code.verification: The Modal image definition clones this repository, checks out this exact revision, initializes submodules, and installs the package; the pinned revision README is reachable at the official source URL.

model_checkpoint.hash_note: The read-only cache probe exposed the content-addressed Hugging Face blob identifier and file size, but did not stream-hash the 13.77 GB checkpoint. The blob identifier is not promoted here as an independently recomputed content hash.

revision_reconciliation.why_revisions_differ: The source revision identifies the executable Evo2 Python/CUDA implementation, while the Hugging Face snapshot revision identifies the separately versioned model repository contents and checkpoint snapshot. They are expected to be different identifiers and are reconciled by the loader contract, not by comparing their hash strings.
